name: @reticlehq/server
description: Reticle bridge + MCP server. Hosts the browser WS endpoint and exposes MCP tools to the coding agent.

scripts.prepack: node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs --clean dist && tsc -b --force && node ../scripts/alias-dist.mjs && node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/stamp-issuer-key.mjs && node ../scripts/pack-docs.mjs

author: Reticle contributors

reticle.changelog: An MCP server that stays up when the daemon dies, one tool surface instead of five profiles (`RETICLE_TOOL_PROFILE` retired for `RETICLE_ADVERTISE_ALL_TOOLS`), and tools that refuse instead of answering wrongly.
breakingChanges: The default MCP surface is the merged nine. reticle_snapshot/query/inspect/state -> reticle_look { action }, reticle_network/console -> reticle_observe { action }, reticle_sessions/feedback -> reticle_session { action }, reticle_wait_for -> reticle_assert { action: "wait" }, reticle_act_sequence -> reticle_act { steps }. Old names redirect when CALLED, but an allowedTools allowlist or an MCP permission rule naming one refuses first — update those by hand.

RETICLE_TOOL_PROFILE is retired. Set RETICLE_ADVERTISE_ALL_TOOLS=1 on the daemon to advertise the full table, which is the only way to reach reticle_screenshot, reticle_visual_diff, reticle_storage, reticle_network_mock and reticle_clock.
